sutta: 55.1.2 the sutapana has confidence in the buddha dharma and sangha and he possesses pure sila or pure moral conduct these are the characteristics of a stream enter a sota panda then finally we see that in the um in the sutas and vinaya uh the persons who attain stream entry uh always seem to uh do so when they listen to the uh suit us just as we have them today just as we listen to them today and whenever the the buddha spoke with the sutas some people seem to attain stream entry even though they had not meditated before even though they had not listened to the dhamma even which means hearers or listeners and that all the disciples of the buddha were listeners hearers of his discourses and this shows again the importance of hearing the discourses because when his disciples listen to the discourses they attain unshakable faith in the buddha they understood the sutas because they paid proper attention and they had unshakable faith and from there they practiced further the meditations etc and they attain higher levels of arya hood so this all shows the importance of listening to the sutas as the very foundation in the spiritual path and much learning is one of the factors one of the important conditions in the in the spiritual path so listening to the buddha's discourses is very much to be encouraged
